lines.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, writes with Timothy to Philemon, Apphia, Archippus, and the church in Philemon's house.
Paul always thanks God for Philemon, hearing of his faith in the Lord Jesus and love for the saints.
Paul appeals for Onesimus, whose father he became in the wilderness, and sends him back, calling him his very heart.
Paul asks Philemon to receive Onesimus as a beloved brother, and to charge any debt to Paul's church.
Paul asks Philemon to prepare a guest room, and Epaphras, his fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends greetings.
